review_description: Our Installer was great.Eoplly on the other hand is a disappointment as they are un-contactable. Not good enough for a company of this size!

I needed to wait for permission from the Body Corporate to install the system and was delayed by roof repairs scheduled by the Body Corporate, the company was flexible and patient with delays.The installers were also efficient and pretty tidy. The electrician was very professional and very tidy and I would use him again for any electrical work I needed.
The installer is local and been in business for over 25 years. He visited us and fullly discussed systems and merits etc. and we were comfortable dealing with him.
